correctness.rationale: The four exact affine branches of H=T² have slope magnitude 4; the forward-invariant dyadic hole-boundary partition produces the stated primitive adjacency matrix with exact transitions. Perron row elimination yields λ^k(4−λ)=2 or 1; graph-directed cylinder lengths give both Hausdorff dimension and the all-time tail. Solving δ(1−δ)^k=p yields γ=p+(k+1/2)p²+O(k²p³); the plateau image and critical orbit prove the odd superstable cycle versus even finite capture by the repelling fixed point. Independently rebuilt the exact rational Markov matrix and characteristic polynomial for m=1..11 and checked direct rational cylinder first-hit probabilities for m=1..4, n=1..3. Those bounded checks are not substituted for the indexed argument.
